Rerun should either drop the schema citation or explicitly note this is an emergent pattern not yet covered by the populated schema (schema itself lists 'solar_for_secondary_structure' as TBD). Fix by moving/clarifying that the alternative-structure miss applies to the 03:43-04:16 window (which coaching_focus priority 1 already correctly identifies), not to the 01:35 concession itself. (3) The scope-creep example at 02:55 undersells the duration of the rep's unprompted technical explanation -- it actually begins around 02:17 ('we look at your electric bill... try to offset your bill with that many panels'). Rerun should anchor the scope-creep cherry-pick moment to 02:17 as the start point to accurately capture the full extent of the closer-tier content delivered.
